name: Beta presets (beta_33, beta_44, beta_53, …)
plain: Core beta scheduler re-registered with fixed α and β values as named scheduler entries. Three of them also add steps silently before computing, so a 20-step request returns more steps: beta_32 and beta_43 add 1 per 20 steps; beta_42 adds 1 per 10.
math:
Same as core beta with (α,β): beta_33 (.3,.3), beta_44 (.4,.4), beta_53 (.5,.3), beta_54 (.5,.4), beta_57 (.5,.7), beta_32 (.3,.2), beta_43 (.4,.3), beta_42 (.4,.2).
n = steps + ⌊steps/20⌋ for 32 and 43; n = steps + ⌊steps/10⌋ for 42.

providers.author: Artificial-Sweetener
providers.note: beta57 calls core beta_scheduler with fixed constants, simple_syrup/runtime/sampling_schedulers.py:308
